messages:
Maya: Quick thread — drafting the release notes for tomorrow's deploy (staging -> prod). Short checklist: KV-cache feature flag, quantization tweak for embed-model, embeddings index reindex. Need pin decisions, staging smoke window, and rollback criteria.

Kevin: SG. Paste the draft here and I'll tidy copy.

Maya: Draft below (high level):

```
- What: Enable KV-prefix caching to reduce token cost for chat flows (opt-in flag).
- Why: Cuts repeated prefix compute, ~18% token cost improvement for customer X workload.
- Risk: Cache invalidation edge-case for streaming reconnects (covered in rollback).
- Ops notes: roll forward only after staging smoke (20:30 UTC). Pin runtime v1.12.3 + model:v3-quant.
- Migration: embeddings index update requires a short reindex job; will run during staging cutover.
```

Samir: Oncall window ok from 20:15-23:00 UTC, I can latch. What's the explicit rollback trigger set?

Maya: Rollback criteria (short): 
- Production error-rate (5xx) > 1.5% sustained for 5m OR request latency p95 increases > 2x baseline for 10m.
- Eval regression on smoke promptset: output timeout or misformatted JSON (see test set).
- If cache inconsistency observed (duplicate tokens in stream) immediate rollback.

Anna: Pin request noted. We should pin both runtime and model binary. Requesting: runtime:v1.12.3 (immutable), model:v3-quant-pin-2026-03-20. TTL for pin should be 72h.

deploybot: :gear: deploybot scheduled 
- staging deploy: 2026-03-20 20:30:00 UTC
- prod tentative promote: 2026-03-20 21:15:00 UTC (after 20m canary + smoke)
- deploy command: `deploybot promote --env staging --pin runtime:v1.12.3 --model model:v3-quant-pin-2026-03-20`

OpsOnCall: I'll monitor canary. Runbook for rollback (short):
1) Pause incoming traffic to canary pool (routed to fallback).
2) Trigger `deploybot rollback --to-pin previous` and revert flag `feature.kv_cache=false`.
3) Run lightweight reindex check and verify errors cleared.
4) If unresolved after 15m, escalate to oncall-2 and open incident.

Kevin: Tiny copy edits to RN: swap 'Why' & 'Risk' order, add one-line customer impact example, and include link to smoke promptset: https://confluence/redwood/rn/smoke-prompts

Maya: Thanks. I'll update Confluence with the final RN, attach canary metrics dashboard, and post the internal announcement 30m before staging. Ping @OpsOnCall when pins are set so we can start smoke. :thumbsup:

Samir: Acknowledged, I'll be on the thread during the window and will call rollback if thresholds hit.

Kevin: Looks good. If Maya posts final copy I'll publish the internal blurb.

Maya: Final: done. Publishing now and setting pins. I'll notify here once deploybot shows staging success.

deploybot: :white_check_mark: staging deploy succeeded at 2026-03-20 20:31:12 UTC (canary 3/3 healthy).

OpsOnCall: Watching metrics now.

Maya: Closing thread for now — will reopen if anything changes.
